proof: Both parameters optimize the largest order-shattered-set size over the same set of domain orders; a maximum is at least the corresponding minimum.
name: Maximum Largest Order Shattered Set / Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set
witness_verification: For #classes/addressing with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs. The projected/order-shattering endpoint value uses its established finite-class equality with VC dimension.
